summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 1, 2026 press release disclosing a CFO transition. Elijah Tyshynski assumed the CFO role effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Alexander Dann. The change follows the company's August 25, 2026 announcement of a planned leadership succession, indicating an orderly, pre-signaled transition rather than an abrupt forced departure. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report mapping to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. Watch for further succession developments and execution at the Cariboo Gold Project.
